visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man and a woman are seen on a large bed with gray sheets in a modern, brightly lit bedroom. The woman sits upright in a red silk nightgown, focusing on her smartphone with a neutral expression. Next to her, a man in a white tank top and black shorts performs series of rhythmic, acrobatic rotations and leg kicks while lying face down, his movements appearing erratic and energetic. (2) The camera zooms into a medium shot of the woman. She looks away from her phone with a weary sigh, expressing mild annoyance. She then proceeds to gather her long hair and tie it into a ponytail using both hands. (3) The scene cuts to a wider shot where the man is now lying quietly with his head resting on the woman's lap. She gently strokes his hair as he appears to sleep. The camera then zooms in on the man's face and his tattooed arm, showing him resting peacefully while soft, warm lighting illuminates the scene.
